name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Adopt the 4px #005fcc outer ring with a 2px white inner ring for focus indicators. This keeps the ring visible against any background while avoiding excessive thickness that could obscure content. The trade-off is slightly larger focus rings, but they remain within WCAG’s minimum 2px requirement and improve clarity for keyboard users.

name: Reader
text: The 4px #005fcc ring risks blending on patterned backgrounds where #005fcc’s contrast drops below 3:1 against busy textures. A 3px #ffffff ring with a 1px #005fcc outer edge meets WCAG 2.1 AA (4.5:1) on all backgrounds while keeping the indicator crisp. Test this on high-contrast patterned backgrounds to confirm visibility.

name: Ramp
text:
Adopt the 3px #000 outer ring with a 1px white inner ring. This guarantees 7:1 contrast on any background, passing WCAG 2.1 AA for focus indicators without blending into patterns or dark colors. The trade-off is a slightly softer ring on light backgrounds, but it remains visible and meets the strictest accessibility standard.

name: Reader
